completeness.note: Checks the physiological data array. Not affected by label cleaning.

conformance.note: Checks data array shape and dtype. Not affected by label cleaning.

cross_source.note: dat labels vs participant_ratings.xls. Corrected by label cleaning.

structure.note: Shape uniformity across participants. Not affected by label cleaning.

physiological_plausibility.reason: Peripheral channel units and preprocessing in the preprocessed release are not documented in available sources. GSR has negative values across participants; Koelstra et al. (2012, p. 27) describe GSR detrending for their own analysis, but whether this applies to the released files is not stated. Temp channel range differs markedly across participants (Group A, s01-s23 and s25: range under 10 per participant; Group B, s24 and s26-s32: range over 500 per participant); cause of the split is undocumented. Resp and BVP units are not stated in the paper.

timeliness.reason: All 40 channels share a single sample clock per participant. No cross-device temporal alignment is needed.

note: overall_pass reflects the Gold (after-cleaning) state. label_plausibility and cross_source dimensions show before/after. completeness, conformance, and structure check the data array and are unaffected by label cleaning.
